changes.title: See How Houthis Put the Red Sea at Risk as an Alternative Oil Route
changes.summary: Saudi Arabia has diverted huge amounts of oil to the Red Sea since the Iran war began, but now the Iranian-backed Houthi militants say that they intend to block that route.

changes.title: How the Trump Administration’s Nuclear Deal With Saudi Arabia May Work
changes.summary: The Trump administration is expected to announce an agreement with Saudi Arabia on a civilian nuclear program. Such deals, known as 123 Agreements, are designed to prevent the development of weapons.

changes.title: Coveted U.S. Nuclear Deal Is a Coup for Saudi Crown Prince
changes.summary: Saudi Arabia had for years sought the controversial deal to transfer American nuclear technology to the kingdom. It is expected to be sealed on Wednesday.

changes.title: Trump approves landmark U.S.-Saudi nuclear deal
changes.summary: President Donald Trump has approved a landmark civilian nuclear deal between the United States and Saudi Arabia that is expected to be announced Wednesday, a senior administration official told NBC News.
